scripts.extension:package: npm run extension:build && cd extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/fangkittipat/eventstorming/raw/main/extension --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/fangkittipat/eventstorming/raw/main/extension
scripts.extension:publish: npm run extension:build && cd extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce publish --baseContentUrl https://github.com/fangkittipat/eventstorming/raw/main/extension --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/fangkittipat/eventstorming/raw/main/extension
scripts.extension:publish:ovsx: npm run extension:package && cd extension && npx --yes ovsx publish eventstorm-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").vsix
